name: millionverifier_verify
description: Verify a single email address with MillionVerifier. Returns result (ok/catch_all/disposable/invalid/unknown), a quality label, and free/role flags. Example: millionverifier_verify({ email: "jane@stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-millionverifier-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your MillionVerifier API key (find it at app.millionverifier.com/api).
